Meet Debbie

“With over 10 years of experience in hairstyling, Debbie is passionate about creating beautiful styles while prioritizing the health and integrity of your hair. She believes that great hairstyling is about more than just the finished look. It’s about caring for your hair, protecting its strength, and helping you maintain your length. Known for her efficiency and attention to detail, Debbie works diligently to deliver quality results without compromising on the finish. Every style is approached with care, precision, and a commitment to neat, polished results.”

Book a house call

How house calls work

Simple and stress-free, all from the comfort of your home.

1

Message Debbie

Tell her the style you want, your preferred dates and where you are.

2

Secure your spot

A 5% deposit is required to confirm your booking.

3

She comes to you

Debbie is based in the St. Ann area and travels to wherever you are. She brings everything with her, including the braiding hair.

4

Pay in cash

Pay the remaining balance in cash. The travel fee is already included in the price.
